summary: Completed frontend testing of Firebase social platform. Authentication and UI working correctly, but critical Firebase Firestore permissions blocking core functionality.

integration_issues.issue: Firebase Firestore permissions error - 'Missing or insufficient permissions' blocking all post operations
User sessions not fully persisting between browser sessions - auth state lost on new page loads
Posts fetching fails with Firestore permissions error, showing 'Error loading posts' message to users

passed_tests: Login page loads with glassmorphism UI design
Signup form creates users in Firebase Auth successfully
Login form authenticates existing users correctly
Route protection works (redirects unauthenticated users to login)
Feed page UI loads and displays correctly
Post creation form UI is accessible and functional
UI responsiveness and styling working properly
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix Firebase Firestore security rules to allow authenticated users to read/write posts and members collections. Current permissions are blocking all post creation and fetching operations. Also investigate auth persistence configuration to ensure sessions survive browser restarts.
